what: Sources of data/sha_sim_inputs.js / .json (Phase 3 day plan inputs, package P3-A)

sections.profile, totals, weights, typeMix, turna: aggregates of the observed-elsewhere data (ODbL 1.0) and published facts; typeMix: every airline x type count cell < 3 merged; weights: per-airline shares that mirror the Phase 1 counts committed in docs/phase1/observed_elsewhere_stats.json (not merged: a cell can stand for 1-2 callsigns a day; nothing beyond the committed counts); no identity, no per-flight time
sections.published: published schedule facts, not observed-elsewhere data (HKG: DATA.GOV.HK terms; TSA: OGDL v1.0); the only section where flight numbers occur; allow-listed by tools/sim/audit_identity.py only for flight numbers that occur in refs/cache/schedules_open/
sections.notams: NOTAM effect records (ids, windows, targets) from the CAAC eAIP NOTAM Summary (OD3 short facts)
sections.params: design parameters [inf], each with its basis
